description: RAG pipeline and MCP server for credit union call center supervisors.

people.description: Queries call transcripts and CSAT survey data using natural language via an MCP-compatible client such as Claude Desktop.
people.name: Credit Union Supervisor

relationships.description: Queries call transcripts and CSAT data

components.description: Registers the three MCP tool definitions (name, description, inputSchema) with the MCP SDK.
components.name: list_tools handler

components.description: Routes incoming tool calls by name to the correct tool function. Wraps results in TextContent.
components.name: call_tool handler

components.description: Initialises the stdio_server context manager and starts the MCP application.
components.name: main()

components.description: Accepts a natural-language query and optional k. Delegates to rag_query(). Returns an AI-generated answer grounded in the top-k retrieved transcripts.
components.name: search_transcripts()

components.description: Accepts a call_id. Retrieves the matching transcript via retrieve() then calls rag_query() to produce a concise summary.
components.name: get_call_summary()

components.description: Accepts optional score range and category. Loads csat.json directly from disk. Filters in-memory. Does not touch pgvector or OpenAI.
components.name: query_csat()

relationships.description: reads csat.json — bypasses vector store entirely

containers.description: Async stdio/HTTP server. Registers tool schemas and dispatches incoming tool calls. Entry point: mcp/server.py. Tool implementations: mcp/tools.py.
containers.name: MCP Server

components.description: Reads data/synthetic/transcripts.json from disk and returns a list of raw dicts.
components.name: load_synthetic_data()

components.description: Converts raw transcript dicts into LangChain Document objects, preserving call_id, date, category, outcome, and agent/member IDs as metadata.
components.name: transcripts_to_documents()

components.description: Orchestrates the full ingestion path: load → convert → embed → store. Accepts source='synthetic' (live) or 's3' (NotImplementedError). No deduplication guard.
components.name: ingest()

relationships.description: converts raw dicts to LangChain Documents

components.description: Calls vector_store.similarity_search(query, k). Returns the top-k most semantically similar Document objects.
components.name: retrieve()

components.description: Calls retrieve(), formats document context, builds a system prompt, invokes gpt-4o-mini via ChatOpenAI, and returns response.content.
components.name: rag_query()

containers.description: Orchestrates data ingestion, semantic retrieval, and answer synthesis. rag/pipeline.py.
containers.name: RAG Pipeline

components.description: Returns OpenAIEmbeddings(model='text-embedding-3-small', dimensions=1536). This function is the sole provider-coupling point for embeddings.
components.name: get_embeddings()

components.description: Returns a PGVector instance bound to the call_transcripts collection and the DATABASE_URL connection string. Calls get_embeddings() if none is supplied.
components.name: get_vector_store()

relationships.description: calls get_embeddings() when no embeddings are supplied
reads and writes embeddings via psycopg2

containers.description: Wraps the embedding model and vector store. Swapping LLM providers requires editing only this file. rag/embeddings.py.
containers.name: Embeddings Module

relationships.description: Vectorises text via OpenAI Embeddings API
Reads and writes embeddings via PGVector / psycopg2

containers.description: Stores 1536-dimension call transcript embeddings in the call_transcripts collection. Local dev: Docker pgvector/pgvector:pg16. Production: Azure PostgreSQL Flexible Server 16 with pgvector extension.
containers.name: PostgreSQL + pgvector

containers.description: Synthetic JSON files on disk. transcripts.json holds 150 call records with full dialogue. csat.json holds ~112 CSAT survey records (75% response rate). Generated by data/synthetic/generate_data.py.
containers.name: Data Files

softwareSystems.description: Python RAG pipeline and MCP server. Exposes call center data as three tools to any MCP-compatible AI client.
softwareSystems.name: Contact Center AI

softwareSystems.description: Provides text-embedding-3-small for document and query vectorisation, and gpt-4o-mini for answer synthesis.
softwareSystems.name: OpenAI API

softwareSystems.description: Production host for the MCP server. Linux B2 plan. Defined in infra/terraform/main.tf.
softwareSystems.name: Azure App Service

softwareSystems.description: Intercepts every inbound HTTP request to App Service before it reaches Python code. Validates OAuth 2.0 Bearer tokens against the registered app audience. No auth logic exists in the Python application.
softwareSystems.name: Microsoft Entra (Easy Auth)

relationships.description: Intercepts requests and validates Bearer tokens

softwareSystems.description: Planned source for production call recordings and transcripts. pipeline.py raises NotImplementedError for the 's3' source path.
softwareSystems.name: AWS S3

componentViews.description: mcp/server.py handlers and mcp/tools.py functions run in a single Python process. query_csat() is the only tool that does not call into the RAG pipeline.

componentViews.title: Component View — MCP Server and Tools

componentViews.description: rag/pipeline.py functions. Ingestion has no deduplication guard — running ingest() twice creates duplicate rows. LangChain provides the provider-abstraction boundary.
componentViews.name: Component View: Contact Center AI - RAG Pipeline
componentViews.title: Component View — RAG Pipeline

componentViews.description: rag/embeddings.py. get_embeddings() and get_vector_store() are the only two coupling points to OpenAI and pgvector. Swapping providers requires editing only this file.
componentViews.name: Component View: Contact Center AI - Embeddings Module
componentViews.title: Component View — Embeddings Module

containerViews.description: Six runtime and storage containers. The CSAT query path (mcpServer → dataFiles) bypasses pgvector and OpenAI entirely.
containerViews.name: Container View: Contact Center AI
containerViews.title: Container View — Contact Center AI

dynamicViews.description: Triggered by: python rag/pipeline.py --ingest. csat.json is not ingested — it is read directly at query time.
dynamicViews.name: Dynamic View: Contact Center AI

relationships.description: 2. transcripts_to_documents() converts records to LangChain Documents, then calls get_vector_store()
3. get_embeddings() vectorises each document — text-embedding-3-small, 1536 dimensions
4. PGVector initialises schema and indexes on first run
5. vector_store.add_documents() inserts embeddings and call metadata — no dedup guard

dynamicViews.title: RAG Query Flow — search_transcripts / get_call_summary

dynamicViews.description: CSAT data is not in pgvector. query_csat() bypasses the entire RAG pipeline — it reads the JSON file directly and filters in-memory. If query volume or dataset size grows, this path needs a SQL-backed approach.
dynamicViews.name: Dynamic View: Contact Center AI

relationships.description: 2. query_csat() loads csat.json — in-memory filter by score range and category. No pgvector. No OpenAI.
